speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our evaluation, how old is the child and for how long have these skin lesions been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum. The history of multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on an unvaccinated child's abdomen, combined with recent exposure to a sibling with chickenpox and a peer with similar lesions, is classic for this viral skin infection.
